description: PostgreSQL 18 int2vector and oidvector validation, canonical text, nested arrays, storage, and catalog identity
sql: CREATE TABLE type_matrix_catalog_vectors (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, small_ids INT2VECTOR, object_ids OIDVECTOR, small_history INT2VECTOR[], object_history OIDVECTOR[]);
INSERT INTO type_matrix_catalog_vectors VALUES (1, '1 2 -3', '1 2 -1', ARRAY['1 2'::int2vector, '-3 4'::int2vector], ARRAY['1 2'::oidvector, '-1'::oidvector]);
SELECT small_ids, object_ids, small_history, object_history FROM type_matrix_catalog_vectors WHERE id = 1;
SELECT oid, typarray, typelem FROM pg_type WHERE typname IN ('int2vector', 'oidvector') ORDER BY oid;
